TR Warszawa  (also , ) is a theatre on Marszałkowska Street in Warsaw, Poland.
History
Its history began in 1945, when a stage of the Municipal Dramatic Theatres () was opened in the basement at 8 Marszałkowska Street. TR Warszawa has existed as an independent entity since 1972. The theatre has operated under various names:  (1948–1949), later  () then  () and again as .
